title: Smart data models - Sampler schema
description: A device that is used by, or implements, a Sampling Procedure to create or transform one or more samples.

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be equal to `Sampler`

madeSampling.description: Property. Model: ''. Relation between a Sampler (sampling device or entity) and the Sampling act it performed.

isHostedBy.description: Property. Model: ''. Relation between a Sensor, Actuator, Sampler, or Platform, and the Platform that it is mounted on or hosted by.
